notes.title: Luna Sky RDX 2.0.1 patch update
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed with today's patch:
[list]
[*] Boss 3 "Carrier" FX rendering problems on AMD GPU. Was caused by a shader incompatible with AMD.
[*] Some Boss 3 shields did not always render.
[*] Two bouncy wheels in "Ekistic Infinity" had no collision detection.
[/list]

Big thanks to the people who reported and please contact us if there are more bugs!
